native_findings.title: Purpose and lifecycle use cases
native_findings.native_meaning: Process-device information spans identification, diagnostic information, process values and configuration. Telemetric and asset-management use cases motivate the model; a use-case listing does not establish that every operation has a detailed mandatory field or is implemented.
native_findings.standing: Descriptive scope/use-case intent
native_findings.contact: Selected original and reference prose read

native_findings.title: Dictionary identity and definition authority
native_findings.native_meaning: Semantic dictionary references identify device classes and properties; referenced dictionary definitions govern their meaning. Display names are constrained by the specified dictionary naming rules, rather than being interchangeable with semantic identifiers.
native_findings.standing: Normative definition and naming constraints; external dictionary entries not yet read
native_findings.contact: Selected original and reference prose read

native_findings.title: Semantic references on instances
native_findings.native_meaning: The text requires dictionary references from types, supertypes and instance declarations to survive instantiation and overriding. It explicitly notes that non-hierarchical references are not automatically created by ordinary model instantiation.
native_findings.standing: Normative obligation plus explanatory implementation warning; no implementation claim
native_findings.contact: Selected original and reference prose read

native_findings.title: Physical device, modular subdevices and multiple representations
native_findings.native_meaning: The base device combines administration, signal and inherited health interfaces and allows modular subdevices. Separate companion representations can refer to the same real-world device; neither an interface nor a second representation automatically denotes another physical asset.
native_findings.standing: Descriptive model structure and cross-specification guidance; targeted SubDevices/SupportedTypes member semantics checked against declared DI1.04 dependency.
native_findings.contact: Selected original and reference prose read
native_findings.figure_reconciliation: Original Figure7 and section7.2 corroborate modular SubDevices with constrained SupportedTypes, checked against declared DI1.04 nodes1004/5004/6026. Corrected one missed existing-row correspondence; no new row.

native_findings.title: Analyser devices and analytical signals
native_findings.native_meaning: The source distinguishes process-analyser device types from associated analytical signal types and interfaces. Their exact content and applicability remain to be reviewed; type-name enumeration does not itself justify additional master rows.
native_findings.standing: Descriptive overview; figures and specialized type definitions unreviewed
native_findings.contact: Selected original and reference prose read

native_findings.title: Optional provision with defined behavior
native_findings.native_meaning: Mandatory functionality is required; optional functionality may be absent, but provision of it entails the specified behavior. Optionality does not mean vendor-defined semantics or evidence of installed capability.
native_findings.standing: Normative applicability constraint
native_findings.contact: Selected original and reference prose read

native_findings.title: Default units
native_findings.native_meaning: The source recommends the primary IEC dictionary unit as the default and permits modification where applicable. Preserve the difference between a recommended default, permitted modification and a universal mandatory unit.
native_findings.standing: Recommendation and permission; dictionary unit definitions pending
native_findings.contact: Selected original and reference prose read
native_findings.supporting_interpretation: Separate dictionary primary units, model defaults and mandated field encodings: duration hours versus encoded milliseconds; volume pulse cubic metres versus specified litres; pH sensing impedance megaohms versus default ohms. Convert magnitudes explicitly; do not infer incompatibility merely from unit labels.

native_findings.title: Inherited Devices version boundary
native_findings.native_meaning: The pinned PA-DIM model declares Devices 1.04.0 and OPC UA core 1.05.02, while the separately completed Devices donor review used 1.05.0. Inherited facts require edition-qualified tracing; they are not automatically new PA-DIM contributions or wholesale imports from the later Devices assessment.
native_findings.standing: Machine-readable dependency declaration and research constraint
native_findings.contact: Pinned model metadata read

native_findings.title: Inherited identification with stronger requirements
native_findings.native_meaning: PA-DIM makes selected inherited manufacturer/model/serial/product/revision/instance/tag facts mandatory and narrows device-revision representation. Inheritance does not mean the constraints are unchanged or that every Devices feature is included.
native_findings.standing: Normative type declarations and constraints
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Local display language and parameter-change time
native_findings.native_meaning: Local display language is distinct from client locale. DateOfLastChange concerns the last device-parameter change and is timestamped in the OPC UA Server; it is not automatically a physical-event time or a complete audit history.
native_findings.standing: Optional properties with source-specific time rule
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Identified measurement/control points and signal containers
native_findings.native_meaning: SignalTag identifies a measuring or control point. SignalSet contains SignalType instances; signal identity, process-value representation and device identity must remain distinct.
native_findings.standing: Normative object structure; SignalTag mandatory
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Condition subjects and component scope
native_findings.native_meaning: Separate device, device-component and signal condition containers attach condition information to the correct subject. A temperature at an internal component location is not automatically the environmental process quantity being measured.
native_findings.standing: Optional condition structures; specific subject qualification
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Reported, actual and simulated values
native_findings.native_meaning: Reported Value may select a simulated value while ActualValue retains the unsimulated process value. Preserve ActualValue, SimulationValue and SimulationState separately, with common engineering units in the analog definition.
native_findings.standing: Optional simulation components; explicit source semantics
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Signal damping time constant
native_findings.native_meaning: Damping is a time in seconds with a first-order 63.2-percent response meaning. It is not simply reporting interval, latency or sample frequency.
native_findings.standing: Optional parameter; borrowed dictionary definition as reproduced in PA-DIM
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Signal-scoped calibration records
native_findings.native_meaning: CalibrationTimestamp identifies calibration of a measurement channel; TypeOfCalibration identifies purpose, and repeated calibration containers can belong to one signal. These are not merely a current calibrating Boolean or success result.
native_findings.standing: Optional fields and optional placeholder containers
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Calibration points and measurand-dependent meanings
native_findings.native_meaning: Calibration point sets can contain optional input-setpoint and actual-readout components. Their dictionary identities depend on the kind of analytical measurement; do not require both optional values or impose one global calibration quantity.
native_findings.standing: Optional components; normative selection of applicable dictionary entries
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Calibration characteristics by sensing technique
native_findings.native_meaning: Cell constant, sensor slope, zero point and pH asymmetry potential preserve technique-specific meanings. Several reflect the last calibration rather than current live readings. Do not equate differently dimensioned slopes or every zero-point definition.
native_findings.standing: Optional technique-specific properties; external dictionary originals not independently read
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review
native_findings.additional_interpretation: Catalytic SensorValue (called SensingValue in explanatory prose) is bridge voltage at calibration, not an unqualified live signal. PA-Q007 retains the undefined specialized calibration-interface reference.

native_findings.title: Calibration conditions and measured response
native_findings.native_meaning: Absolute air pressure during the last calibration and t90 determined by that calibration describe calibration circumstances and response, not current ambient pressure or a generic nominal response specification.
native_findings.standing: Optional calibration evidence
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Segmented chromatograph calibration
native_findings.native_meaning: Three named ranges associate response factors with lower and upper concentration boundaries. Preserve range-specific factor associations rather than flattening to one coefficient or process operating range.
native_findings.standing: Optional range groups
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Degradation indicator versus remaining time
native_findings.native_meaning: ResidualLife and related device/component/source indicators describe degradation on a 1-good to 0-bad scale. Residual sensitivity may be calculated during calibration. Neither name establishes an estimated remaining time, a maintenance guarantee or interchangeable measurement basis.
native_findings.standing: Defined condition indicators; infrared prose/model conflict retained
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Auxiliary supply, sample-path and sensing conditions
native_findings.native_meaning: Auxiliary gas supply, sample gas/liquid flow, sample/sensor/reactor/cooler/laser temperatures, pressures and reagent levels refer to distinct subjects. Requested reference injection volume differs from actual injected volume; condition measurements are not automatically primary process outputs.
native_findings.standing: Optional technique-specific condition variables; additional default/reference tables pending
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review
native_findings.additional_interpretation: RelativeGasFlowRate is a0–100 good/bad condition measure, not an absolute volumetric flow. Sensing and reference impedances are temperature-compensated to25°C in the pH definitions.

native_findings.title: Technique-specific signal quality and residuals
native_findings.native_meaning: Baseline noise, signal-to-noise ratio, fit correlation, transmission ratio, Mahalanobis distance, spectral residual and electronic read noise are different diagnostics. Keep each basis and technique; do not turn all into an unqualified confidence score.
native_findings.standing: Optional diagnostics; complete encoding/default reconciliation pending
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Cleaning and sterilization histories
native_findings.native_meaning: Counters record sensor cleaning-in-place and sterilization-in-place events separately. They are not generic transitions into active operation, elapsed use or proof of successful maintenance.
native_findings.standing: Optional event counters
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Fixed and dynamic next-calibration intervals
native_findings.native_meaning: Some families provide a combined next-calibration interval; others distinguish configured-interval calculations from estimates based on operational/history information. Preserve basis and units; these values are not the latest calibration timestamp or a guarantee.
native_findings.standing: Optional scheduling/estimation information
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Exposure consumption and overload history
native_findings.native_meaning: Accumulated gas dosage, extrapolated peak concentration on overload and accumulated overload duration answer different questions from operating time and present concentration. Keep dosage dimensions and extrapolated versus directly measured standing.
native_findings.standing: Optional stress/exposure variables
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Chromatogram features and sample-event timing
native_findings.native_meaning: Per-signal peak width/height/area/tailing, expected versus actual retention time, injection timestamp and medium name differ from device-wide total peak area or baseline noise. Retention duration is not the injection timestamp.
native_findings.standing: Optional analytical feature and event context
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review
native_findings.additional_interpretation: ValveSwitchingCyclesCounter counts valve opening/closing operations and is an array alongside ValveName. Do not assert pairing cardinality or ordering beyond evidence actually read.

native_findings.title: Diagnostic function existence and storage capacity
native_findings.native_meaning: Watchdog describes existence of a fault-detection function, not a live heartbeat or observed successful test. RemainingDataStorageCapacity describes remaining device-data storage in the stated terabyte unit.
native_findings.standing: Optional Boolean capability and storage quantity; no runtime proof
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Control readback, setpoint and direction
native_findings.native_meaning: ControlSignal reports readback, while Setpoint expresses a target. Analog control additionally identifies actuator kind and operating direction; discrete variants retain their state representations. A target does not prove the physical effect occurred.
native_findings.standing: Normative signal/variable structures; detailed discrete-variable definitions pending
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Authorized reset and adjustment requests
native_findings.native_meaning: FactoryReset selects application, communication or full reset scopes. ZeroPointAdjustment initiates a device-specific cycle; AutoAdjustPositioner starts or aborts manufacturer-specific commissioning. Access is restricted; method acceptance is not proof of completion or calibration quality.
native_findings.standing: Normative method contracts; no device execution
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Measurand, matrix and chemical identity
native_findings.native_meaning: The selected measurand belongs to a matrix of possible quantities. Dictionary discriminator, identifier and descriptive label carry different roles; CAS, PAT and user-defined terms are not interchangeable authority levels.
native_findings.standing: Optional analytical metadata and normative structured datatype
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Totalizer pulse scaling and width
native_findings.native_meaning: Pulse quantity associates mass or actual volume with a pulse; pulse width has a separate fixed time unit. Quantity-specific dictionary entries and units must survive mapping; pulse width is not pulse repetition interval.
native_findings.standing: Mandatory type properties with quantity-specific constraints
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: External conformance boundary
native_findings.native_meaning: The document delegates profiles and conformance units to an online database. Category labels and source declarations alone do not demonstrate full external conformance requirements or certification.
native_findings.standing: External reference; detailed profile originals pending
native_findings.contact: Read publisher-reference text; original/core model/figure contact recorded separately in core_review

native_findings.title: Temperature sensing configuration has separate roles
native_findings.native_meaning: SensorType distinguishes RTD material/resistance or thermocouple material/type code and is mandatory within this variable type; optional SensorClass selects the connected sensing-element kind, SensorConnection describes RTD wire count, and SensorReference describes a thermocouple reference junction. SensorType dictionary reference depends on the sensing technology. None is a serial identity or observation value.
native_findings.standing: Type-specific native configuration; some members optional
native_findings.contact: Remaining text read and reconciled with original; targeted model/sheet evidence recorded in remaining_text_review

native_findings.title: Flow cutoff threshold and forward sign convention
native_findings.native_meaning: LowFlowCutOff is a mandatory threshold expressed as percent of measuring span; prose gives a default tied to the EURange high value. Optional FlowDirection configures the sign used for forward flow. Neither describes a measured direction vector or valve state. Preserve the source wording about span/high value rather than inventing a nonzero-range formula.
native_findings.standing: Native flow configuration; mandatory cutoff/optional sign

native_findings.title: Failure replacement output is distinct from fault status
native_findings.native_meaning: FaultState supplies an optional replacement output value on failure, Boolean or multistate according to the control variable. It is distinct from a diagnostic fault indication, a requested Setpoint, and reported readback. OperatingDirection is mandatory for two-state control but optional for multistate control.
native_findings.standing: Native control configuration; optional fallback value
native_findings.contact: Remaining text read and reconciled with original; targeted model/sheet evidence recorded in remaining_text_review

native_findings.title: Operating-condition and normalized process quantities
native_findings.native_meaning: Distinguish mass flow, actual volume flow, volume flow calculated to base conditions, density under operating conditions, pressure and process-material level. A common numeric/unit representation does not establish equivalence between actual and normalized volume. These are quantity semantics, not necessarily separate master rows.
native_findings.standing: Native quantity typing; dictionary revision discrepancies retained
native_findings.contact: Remaining text read and reconciled with original; targeted model/sheet evidence recorded in remaining_text_review

native_findings.title: Enumerated value labels and dictionary identity
native_findings.native_meaning: For a dictionary property with a value list, EnumValues carries preferred names and EnumDictionaryEntries carries the corresponding identifiers at matching positions. The illustrative ECLASS identifiers are placeholders, not verified cross-dictionary equivalences.
native_findings.standing: Mapping rule; illustrative alternative identifiers not established mappings
native_findings.contact: Remaining text read and reconciled with original; targeted model/sheet evidence recorded in remaining_text_review

native_findings.title: Server capabilities and current-user permissions differ
native_findings.native_meaning: Write masks, role permissions, user-specific access, event notification, sampling/historizing and method UserExecutable are distinct server/session-dependent attributes. A type declaration or executable Method does not prove every user may invoke it, nor that event subscription or history is implemented.
native_findings.standing: Explicit server-specific boundary; inherited/core semantics
native_findings.contact: Remaining text read and reconciled with original; targeted model/sheet evidence recorded in remaining_text_review

native_findings.title: Namespace-qualified identity and scalar/array shape
native_findings.native_meaning: Use the namespace URI when resolving model identity; namespace indices are server/session-local and BrowseNames are not globally unique node identifiers. ValueRank distinguishes scalars, arrays and Any; generic spreadsheet array notation must not erase the broader declared Any constraint.
native_findings.standing: Representation rules; not a new physical-device identity model
native_findings.contact: Remaining text read and reconciled with original; targeted model/sheet evidence recorded in remaining_text_review

native_findings.title: Device classification can use dictionary entries without separate PA-DIM subtypes
native_findings.native_meaning: The supporting dictionary sheet associates PADIMType with classifications including accelerometer, electrical current/voltage/power, velocity, weight and multiple level/flow transmitter principles. A dictionary classification is distinct from a separately declared PA-DIM device subtype and does not prove a complete specialized interface for each class. Preserve this breadth when comparing device-kind and sensing-principle information.
native_findings.standing: Supporting semantic classification; no automatic specialized interface or DIM taxonomy adoption

comparison_decisions.reason: Existing row explicitly separates unit identity, quantity meaning and dictionary/version context, and gives explicit concept units precedence over dictionary defaults. PA-DIM adds source-specific EngineeringUnits and dictionary links; preserve encoding-unit conversion and PA-Q011 rather than add a duplicate general unit row.
comparison_decisions.qualification: Dictionary primary unit and encoded field unit may differ; no universal conversion algorithm or full unit-table correctness is established.

comparison_decisions.reason: Existing row already distinguishes powered duration, active duration and transitions into activity, preserves no-reset lifetime semantics and separates resolution from update frequency. PA-DIM inherited DI1.04 counters support this meaning; sensor-specific powered duration requires its own subject qualification.
comparison_decisions.qualification: Do not absorb cleaning/sterilization counts, accumulated gas dosage, overload exposure or normalized residual-life/sensitivity into this row. Preserve dictionary hours versus encoded milliseconds.

comparison_decisions.title: Reported, unsimulated and substituted signal values
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Keep reported Value, unsimulated ActualValue, substituted SimulationValue and simulation state associated with one signal. Analog values share EngineeringUnits; optional components are not mandatory for every device.
comparison_decisions.reason: A generic output or configuration setting does not preserve the value-selection relationship. Existing position-override rows are position-specific; they remain related analogies, not established coverage of arbitrary process signals. Their original ISA evidence has not been reopened for this decision.

comparison_decisions.title: Signal damping time constant
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Represent the first-order 63.2-percent rise/decay time constant in seconds for a qualified signal.
comparison_decisions.reason: A change-trigger threshold or report interval answers when to publish; it does not describe signal smoothing response. Do not infer sampling frequency or end-to-end latency.

comparison_decisions.title: Signal calibration timestamp and purpose
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Associate calibration time and intended-use classification with the measurement channel and its calibration container; preserve optional fields and repeated containers.
comparison_decisions.reason: Current calibration activity/result explicitly excludes calibration dates and methods. Digital-record history is not equipment calibration history, and a held service-history row is not established coverage. No certificate, traceability or successful calibration is inferred.

comparison_decisions.title: Calibration point inputs and readouts
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Keep each calibration point associated with its optional supplied input and optional observed readout, preserving the measurement-dependent quantity and dictionary identity.
comparison_decisions.reason: An unqualified measurement loses the input/readout roles and point association. Neither both optional values nor a universal calibration quantity is required.

comparison_decisions.title: Technique-specific calibration characteristics and conditions
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Associate technique-specific cell constant, slope, zero point, asymmetry potential, calibration pressure and measured t90 with the relevant calibration and subject. Preserve each quantity, unit and last-calibration standing.
comparison_decisions.reason: Generic measurement/configuration rows lose calibration context and distinguish neither calibration conditions nor derived characteristics from live readings. Group related evidence here without asserting interchangeable slopes or zero points; preserve PA-Q004 and PA-Q007. No unsupported universal coefficient schema is proposed.

comparison_decisions.title: Range-specific chromatograph calibration factors
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Preserve the association of each named chromatograph calibration range with its lower/upper concentration boundaries and response factor.
comparison_decisions.reason: Permitted/excluded operating values do not express a calibration factor attached to a range. Keep the three source groups; do not infer continuous interpolation, universal number of segments or endpoint inclusivity absent evidence.

comparison_decisions.title: Cleaning and sterilization event counts
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Represent sensor cleaning-in-place and sterilization-in-place counts with their separate event types and subject.
comparison_decisions.reason: Activity transitions are not maintenance events; a managed health log does not establish these aggregate counts. Counts do not provide dated event records or prove successful maintenance. Do not import DI operation-counter no-reset rules into these distinct counters.

comparison_decisions.title: Remaining interval to next calibration and calculation basis
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Represent time remaining until calibration, preserving configured-interval calculation versus operational/history-based estimate and day units. Retain the combined source property when its basis is not separately reported.
comparison_decisions.reason: Activity/result, remaining equipment capacity and status-report schedules do not express the next-calibration interval with its calculation basis. This is neither the last calibration date nor a guaranteed maintenance deadline.

comparison_decisions.title: Accumulated gas exposure and overload measures
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Retain gas dosage with concentration-times-time dimensions, extrapolated peak concentration upon overload, and accumulated overload duration as distinct measures for the qualified sensor.
comparison_decisions.reason: Powered/active duration loses exposure and overload condition. Lifetime progress does not by itself establish the overload peak or its extrapolated standing. A generic reading or log loses aggregation basis. Do not infer reset policy, exact event times or a remaining-service prediction.

comparison_decisions.title: Dictionary-qualified property meaning and enumerated values
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Associate property meaning with dictionary identity, authority and version; preserve corresponding enumeration labels and semantic identifiers. Keep the model rule requiring semantic references on instances as a PA-DIM qualification.
comparison_decisions.reason: Property declarations alone do not capture authoritative semantic identifiers; unit context and product classes cover different subjects. Do not treat example ECLASS placeholders as verified equivalence.

comparison_decisions.title: Device local display language
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Describe the language selected for the device local display, distinct from client locale or multilingual record text.
comparison_decisions.reason: Multilingual labels are available text alternatives; they do not establish the selected local device language. A generic configuration bundle would hide this explicit presentation setting.

comparison_decisions.title: Last device-parameter change time
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Describe the server-timestamped last change of a device parameter.
comparison_decisions.reason: Record business revision, configuration version and audit events do not establish this timestamp. Preserve server time basis; no changed-parameter identity, full history or physical application is inferred.

comparison_decisions.title: Measurement or control point identifier
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Identify a measurement or control point using its signal tag and source context, separately from the physical device or address used to access its value.
comparison_decisions.reason: Channel addressing and equipment tags identify different referents. SignalSet is an information container, not proof of an independently installed sensor.

comparison_decisions.title: Technique-qualified analytical signal diagnostics
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Retain baseline noise, linear signal/noise ratio, fit correlation, transmission ratio, Mahalanobis distance, spectral residual and electronic read noise with their technique, subject, basis and units.
comparison_decisions.reason: Existing electromagnetic power-ratio row requires bandwidth context and decibels; PA-DIM linear level ratio does not establish that equivalence or a conversion. ISA reference-quantity hold remains. These diagnostics are not interchangeable confidence scores.

comparison_decisions.title: Chromatogram features and sample injection context
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Associate signal peak width, height, area and tailing with expected/actual retention duration, injection timestamp and medium, preserving source optionality and units.
comparison_decisions.reason: An isolated value or event time loses peak/sample relationships. Device total peak area differs from a signal peak area; retention duration differs from injection time. Valve-counter array pairing is not inferred.

comparison_decisions.title: Remaining device-data storage capacity
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Describe remaining capacity for device-data storage, retaining the source terabyte unit.
comparison_decisions.reason: Partition addresses and memory inventory/protection do not report available capacity. No retention time, successful storage or capacity reservation is inferred.

comparison_decisions.title: Control target and readback relationship
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Associate a control signal setpoint with readback and source-qualified actuator kind and operating direction. Preserve analog versus discrete representations and optionality.
comparison_decisions.reason: An issued request, acknowledgement or generic configuration bundle does not describe the stored target/readback relationship. Readback is not inferred from a requested target; source direction is not a geographical vector.

comparison_decisions.title: Totalizer pulse quantity and pulse width
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Associate a totalizer pulse with the mass or actual-volume quantity represented by one pulse and its distinct width/time unit.
comparison_decisions.reason: Detected-signal duration and inter-pulse interval do not describe quantity-per-pulse scaling. Keep quantity-dependent dictionary entries; no normalized-volume equivalence or pulse repetition rate is inferred.

comparison_decisions.title: Temperature sensing element and connection configuration
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Preserve RTD/thermocouple material/type, sensing-element class, RTD wire connection and thermocouple reference-junction roles.
comparison_decisions.reason: Product classification alone loses connection and reference-junction settings; generic settings do not express these distinct roles. SensorType is mandatory within its applicable type, not mandatory for every device; it is not a serial identifier.

comparison_decisions.title: Flow low-cutoff threshold and forward sign convention
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Describe low-flow suppression threshold and forward-flow sign configuration; retain percent-of-span semantics and the source EURange-high default wording.
comparison_decisions.reason: A publication threshold controls reporting rather than suppression of low-flow output. Do not invent a nonzero-range default formula or infer a physical flow direction vector.

comparison_decisions.title: Failure replacement output value
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Represent an optional replacement output value upon failure for a two-state or multistate control signal.
comparison_decisions.reason: A fault assessment, ordinary setpoint and observed readback are different meanings. The replacement value declaration does not prove failure occurred or the output was physically applied.

comparison_decisions.title: Current-user access and method-execution permission
comparison_decisions.proposed_meaning: Describe access rights for the current user/session to a qualified information object or method, separately from general server capability, property mutability and the policy defining rights. Preserve user/session dependence and optional exposure.
comparison_decisions.reason: Policy rules and request metadata do not state effective access for the current session. A task-specific authorization decision differs from an advertised current-user permission. Executable=True does not imply UserExecutable=True for every user.
comparison_decisions.implementation_qualification: Server/session-specific values; no actual authorization or enforcement verified.

inherited_description_groups.name: OperationCycleCounter
inherited_description_groups.description: Operation cycle counter is counting the times the Device switches from not performing an activity to performing an activity. For example, each time a valve starts moving, is counted. This value shall only increase during the lifetime of the Device and shall not be reset when the Device is restarted.

inherited_description_groups.name: OperationDuration
inherited_description_groups.description: Operation duration is the duration the Device has been powered and performing an activity. This counter is intended for Devices where a distinction is made between switched on and in operation. For example, a drive might be powered on but not operating. It is not intended for Devices always performing an activity like sensors always measuring data. This value shall only increase during the lifetime of the Device and shall not be reset when the Device is restarted. The OperationDuration is provided as Duration, i.e., in milliseconds or even fractions of a millisecond. However, the Server is not expected to update the value in such a high frequency, but maybe once a minute or once an hour, depending on the application.

inherited_description_groups.name: PowerOnDuration
inherited_description_groups.description: Power on duration is the duration the Device has been powered. The main purpose is to determine the time in which degradation of the Device occurred. The details, when the time is counted, is implementation-specific. Companion specifications might define specific rules. Typically, when the Device has supply voltage and the main CPU is running, the time is counted. This may include any kind of sleep mode, but may not include pure Wake on LAN. This value shall only increase during the lifetime of the Device and shall not be reset when the Device is restarted. The PowerOnDuration is provided as Duration, i.e., in milliseconds or even fractions of a millisecond. However, the Server is not expected to update the value in such a high frequency, but maybe once a minute or once an hour, depending on the application.

figures.title: General OPC UA enterprise scope
figures.interpretation: Illustrative device, control, enterprise and browser communication scope. Does not establish installed network topology or a new PA-DIM information need.

figures.title: Basic address-space object
figures.interpretation: Reservation, Cancel, When and Who are teaching examples distinguishing an object, method and variables. Do not import their example values or subjects as device requirements.

figures.title: Type definitions and instances
figures.interpretation: PersonType and Who distinguish declarations, inheritance and instance values, including an extended MiddleName. Type support is not evidence of an installed instance.

figures.title: References between objects
figures.interpretation: Hierarchical and nonhierarchical reference examples distinguish organization, ownership, classification and other relationships. A reference does not by itself establish physical containment.

figures.title: Information model notation
figures.interpretation: Object/variable/method/view symbols differ from type symbols; reference, subtype, type-definition and interface arrows have distinct meanings. This qualifies diagram interpretation rather than adding a field.

figures.title: Protocol Independent Information Model
figures.interpretation: PA-DIM device identification, health, process variables, services and parameters are separated from FDI user interface/business rules and proprietary vendor content. Previously read extracted original raster retained.

figures.title: PA-DIM
figures.interpretation: Device identity, administration, health, signal grouping and modular SubDevices are distinct. SubDevices has ConfigurableObjectType with SupportedTypes; this exposed a missed allowed-type/configured-instance correspondence. Original section7.2 and declared DI1.04 model corroborate it; see targeted reconciliation below.

figures.title: Process Analyser Overview
figures.interpretation: Overview distinguishes device/signal types, condition sets and calibration interfaces. Its1.00/1.01 legend is not an exhaustive1.02 inventory. Confirms retained PA-Q014.

figures.title: Process Analyser Types
figures.interpretation: Specialized device classes have separate condition interfaces where shown; the original also uses AmperometricSensorType and omits later types. Preserve release text/model declarations and PA-Q014.

figures.title: Analytical Signal Types
figures.interpretation: Analytical signal types and calibration/condition interfaces are separate from physical device identity. The original overview remains nonexhaustive for1.02; PA-Q014 retained.

figures.title: Integration with FDI Part5 Information Model
figures.interpretation: An FDI Device has a PADIMView AddIn typed by PADIMType; DefaultInstanceBrowseName specifies the recommended name. A second model view is not a second physical device. Confirms existing asset-view qualification.

figures.title: Signal Model Overview
figures.interpretation: Analog, discrete, two-state and multi-state signal variable types have distinct base types. ActualValue, SimulationValue and SimulationState remain separate; Damping is shown for analog signals. Confirms existing simulation/damping proposals.

figures.title: AnalogSignal and Signal Object Model
figures.interpretation: Signal objects, values and adjustment methods are distinct. SignalTag, control setpoint, totalizer pulse, temperature configuration and flow configuration stay subject-qualified. Diagram supports prepared groups; does not make every optional child universal.

figures.title: Simulation
figures.interpretation: SimulationState selects the reported Value between actual and simulation values. Simulated output must not be treated as the actual measurement. Confirms PADIM-SIMULATION-VALUES without another addition.

figures.title: EngineeringUnits with HasDictionaryEntry
figures.interpretation: The unit property can carry its own dictionary reference; signal values retain their unit/range context through the declared variable model. This does not equate every numeric parameter or validate external conversion factors; PA-Q011 remains.

new_classifications.addition_rationale: A generic output or configuration setting does not preserve the value-selection relationship. Existing position-override rows are position-specific; they remain related analogies, not established coverage of arbitrary process signals. Their original ISA evidence has not been reopened for this decision.
A change-trigger threshold or report interval answers when to publish; it does not describe signal smoothing response. Do not infer sampling frequency or end-to-end latency.

Current calibration activity/result explicitly excludes calibration dates and methods. Digital-record history is not equipment calibration history, and a held service-history row is not established coverage. No certificate, traceability or successful calibration is inferred.
An unqualified measurement loses the input/readout roles and point association. Neither both optional values nor a universal calibration quantity is required.

Generic measurement/configuration rows lose calibration context and distinguish neither calibration conditions nor derived characteristics from live readings. Group related evidence here without asserting interchangeable slopes or zero points; preserve PA-Q004 and PA-Q007. No unsupported universal coefficient schema is proposed.

Permitted/excluded operating values do not express a calibration factor attached to a range. Keep the three source groups; do not infer continuous interpolation, universal number of segments or endpoint inclusivity absent evidence.

Activity transitions are not maintenance events; a managed health log does not establish these aggregate counts. Counts do not provide dated event records or prove successful maintenance. Do not import DI operation-counter no-reset rules into these distinct counters.

Activity/result, remaining equipment capacity and status-report schedules do not express the next-calibration interval with its calculation basis. This is neither the last calibration date nor a guaranteed maintenance deadline.

Powered/active duration loses exposure and overload condition. Lifetime progress does not by itself establish the overload peak or its extrapolated standing. A generic reading or log loses aggregation basis. Do not infer reset policy, exact event times or a remaining-service prediction.

Property declarations alone do not capture authoritative semantic identifiers; unit context and product classes cover different subjects. Do not treat example ECLASS placeholders as verified equivalence.
Multilingual labels are available text alternatives; they do not establish the selected local device language. A generic configuration bundle would hide this explicit presentation setting.

Record business revision, configuration version and audit events do not establish this timestamp. Preserve server time basis; no changed-parameter identity, full history or physical application is inferred.
Channel addressing and equipment tags identify different referents. SignalSet is an information container, not proof of an independently installed sensor.

Existing electromagnetic power-ratio row requires bandwidth context and decibels; PA-DIM linear level ratio does not establish that equivalence or a conversion. ISA reference-quantity hold remains. These diagnostics are not interchangeable confidence scores.

An isolated value or event time loses peak/sample relationships. Device total peak area differs from a signal peak area; retention duration differs from injection time. Valve-counter array pairing is not inferred.
Partition addresses and memory inventory/protection do not report available capacity. No retention time, successful storage or capacity reservation is inferred.

An issued request, acknowledgement or generic configuration bundle does not describe the stored target/readback relationship. Readback is not inferred from a requested target; source direction is not a geographical vector.

Detected-signal duration and inter-pulse interval do not describe quantity-per-pulse scaling. Keep quantity-dependent dictionary entries; no normalized-volume equivalence or pulse repetition rate is inferred.

Product classification alone loses connection and reference-junction settings; generic settings do not express these distinct roles. SensorType is mandatory within its applicable type, not mandatory for every device; it is not a serial identifier.
A publication threshold controls reporting rather than suppression of low-flow output. Do not invent a nonzero-range default formula or infer a physical flow direction vector.
A fault assessment, ordinary setpoint and observed readback are different meanings. The replacement value declaration does not prove failure occurred or the output was physically applied.

Policy rules and request metadata do not state effective access for the current session. A task-specific authorization decision differs from an advertised current-user permission. Executable=True does not imply UserExecutable=True for every user.

register_append: Candidate — Reported, unsimulated and substituted signal values

Keep reported Value, unsimulated ActualValue, substituted SimulationValue and simulation state associated with one signal. Analog values share EngineeringUnits; optional components are not mandatory for every device.
OPC 30081 1.02; COMMON_CANDIDATE; declared DI1.04 inheritance only

PA-F013; 8.2.1, 8.2.2, Figure14; A generic output or configuration setting does not preserve the value-selection relationship. Existing position-override rows are position-specific; they remain related analogies, not established coverage of arbitrary process signals. Their original ISA evidence has not been reopened for this decision.
Represent the first-order 63.2-percent rise/decay time constant in seconds for a qualified signal.
OPC 30081 1.02; COMMON_CANDIDATE; declared DI1.04 inheritance only
PA-F014; 8.2.2; A change-trigger threshold or report interval answers when to publish; it does not describe signal smoothing response. Do not infer sampling frequency or end-to-end latency.
Candidate — Signal calibration timestamp and purpose
Associate calibration time and intended-use classification with the measurement channel and its calibration container; preserve optional fields and repeated containers.
OPC 30081 1.02; COMMON_CANDIDATE; declared DI1.04 inheritance only

PA-F015; 7.1.3, 7.26; Current calibration activity/result explicitly excludes calibration dates and methods. Digital-record history is not equipment calibration history, and a held service-history row is not established coverage. No certificate, traceability or successful calibration is inferred.
Candidate — Calibration point inputs and readouts
Keep each calibration point associated with its optional supplied input and optional observed readout, preserving the measurement-dependent quantity and dictionary identity.
OPC 30081 1.02; COMMON_CANDIDATE; declared DI1.04 inheritance only
PA-F016; 7.23, 7.52; An unqualified measurement loses the input/readout roles and point association. Neither both optional values nor a universal calibration quantity is required.
Candidate — Technique-specific calibration characteristics and conditions

Associate technique-specific cell constant, slope, zero point, asymmetry potential, calibration pressure and measured t90 with the relevant calibration and subject. Preserve each quantity, unit and last-calibration standing.
OPC 30081 1.02; SPECIALIZED_CANDIDATE; declared DI1.04 inheritance only

PA-F017, PA-F018; 7.1.4, 7.1.5, 7.1.6, 7.1.8; Generic measurement/configuration rows lose calibration context and distinguish neither calibration conditions nor derived characteristics from live readings. Group related evidence here without asserting interchangeable slopes or zero points; preserve PA-Q004 and PA-Q007. No unsupported universal coefficient schema is proposed.
Preserve the association of each named chromatograph calibration range with its lower/upper concentration boundaries and response factor.
OPC 30081 1.02; SPECIALIZED_CANDIDATE; declared DI1.04 inheritance only

PA-F019; 7.1.7; Permitted/excluded operating values do not express a calibration factor attached to a range. Keep the three source groups; do not infer continuous interpolation, universal number of segments or endpoint inclusivity absent evidence.
Candidate — Cleaning and sterilization event counts
Represent sensor cleaning-in-place and sterilization-in-place counts with their separate event types and subject.
OPC 30081 1.02; SPECIALIZED_CANDIDATE; declared DI1.04 inheritance only

PA-F023; 7.1.22, 7.1.23, 7.1.24, 7.1.26; Activity transitions are not maintenance events; a managed health log does not establish these aggregate counts.
